new_reader.guard: Existing full verified history/immutable-closure reader followed by existing actual display/version read; exact revision AND publication equality; mismatch refuses. No version derived from caller/head/history length; no module cache.

caller_owned_basis.guard: Cold provider and cloned selected target; private basis retained only in store closure; single-use mutate; no caller supplied basis or pin. Returned display/registry cannot mutate the canonical basis.

fresh_postvalidation_pair.guard: Consume initial basis once, await complete authoringBundleFromDocument, then newly load and compare BOTH head IDs before getRecoverableIdentity/createLocalSaveSession. Next retry has no retained basis.
